program.description: 要运行的脚本，相对项目根目录；与 module 二选一 / Script to run, relative to the project root; use either program or module

module.description: 以 python -m 运行的模块，例如 app.main；与 program 二选一 / Module to run as python -m, e.g. app.main; use either module or program

args.description: 传给程序的参数：字符串数组；直接编辑 JSON 时也可写成一个按 shell 规则拆分的命令行字符串（支持引号） / Arguments passed to the program: an array of strings; when editing JSON directly, a single shell-style command-line string (quotes honored) is also accepted

env.description: 额外的环境变量 / Extra environment variables

cwd.description: 工作目录，相对项目根目录，默认项目根目录 / Working directory, relative to the project root (default: the project root)

console.description: 程序的输入输出位置：integratedTerminal 在 MinCode 终端中运行（默认），internalConsole 只在调试控制台显示输出，externalTerminal 请求独立的系统终端窗口（是否真正弹出取决于 MinCode 宿主支持，可能回退到集成终端） / Where the program runs: integratedTerminal runs it in a MinCode terminal (default), internalConsole only shows its output in the debug console, externalTerminal requests a separate OS terminal window (actual launch depends on MinCode host support and may fall back to the integrated terminal)

python.description: Python 解释器路径；留空时依次使用 .venv、venv 与 PATH 上的 python3 / Python interpreter; empty uses .venv, venv, then python3 on PATH

justMyCode.description: 只在自己的代码中停下，跳过标准库与第三方库 / Stop only in your own code, not in the standard library or installed packages

showReturnValue.description: 单步跳出函数时在调试控制台显示返回值 / Show the return value in the debug console when stepping out of a function

subProcess.description: 同时调试 multiprocessing 等派生的子进程 / Also debug child processes spawned via multiprocessing and similar

host.description: debugpy 监听的主机 / Host debugpy listens on

port.description: debugpy 监听的端口 / Port debugpy listens on

pathMappings.description: 本地目录（相对项目根目录）与远程目录的对应关系 / Local directory (relative to the project root) to remote directory mappings

python.description: 运行调试适配器的 Python 解释器，需已安装 debugpy / Interpreter that runs the debug adapter; needs debugpy installed

justMyCode.description: 只在自己的代码中停下 / Stop only in your own code
